payload.text: dc's own limits: no Hammerspoon, pointer, xcodebuild or hv's keychain; no menuz file (utilz-ic's); nothing pushed. Every host run books through Intent's slots on molt-vc's desk (hv's word, molt-vc in control from 13:19:49Z on 26 Oct; vc's watchout 17 has it whole): vc's word on the bytes first, then dc's intent estate slots ask heavy|light with --named tip=<sha> and each script's hash and --node dc, its id sent with the run's details to molt-vc and vc; a run only on molt-vc's GO by name; START and END as slots start and slots release with --node dc (--relayed for a kovacs run, whose START and END come through molt-vc), each also by message to molt-vc and vc; a slots verb's wrote: path committed exactly, as a wb verb's.
